children: rises 3.6% in Tuesday's trading after saying it

a portfolio of U.S. battery energy storage system development projects from Colorado-based Goshe Energy Storage, adding 2.3 GW of BESS development across 15 projects to the company's platform and a team of development and BESS project management professionals.

Financial terms were not disclosed, but the company said the acquired portfolio is anchored by two ready-to-build projects totaling 350 MW, both of which are expected to achieve commercial operations in Q1 2028 and generate ~$30M of combined annual run-rate EBITDA once operational.
also said it secured a credit facility commitment of up to $40M from S2G Investments to support the development, construction, and operations of the acquired portfolio.

The company said the acquisition expands its Asset Vault platform, which is now expected to generate more than $200M in 2028 exit run-rate EBITDA as part of its long-term energy infrastructure ownership model.

"This portfolio fits squarely within Energy Vault's strategy of acquiring late-stage, de-risked development projects that can be moved efficiently toward construction and operation," Asset Vault President Cory Magnuson said.

title: Energy Vault jumps after acquiring 2.3 GW battery storage portfolio
